description: Replays every event of a saved scenario, in order, from this machine to a URL (e.g. the local handler), and reports each step: status, pass or fail, and the verdict against that event's previous replay to the same URL. Use it after a fix to prove a whole flow works, not just one event. Steps go back to back unless keep_timing is set (gaps capped at 5 seconds). Each step is a real webhook delivery recorded in replay history, so it can change state in the receiving app.

keep_timing.description: Wait the recorded gap between steps, up to 5 seconds each

stop_on_failure.description: Stop at the first failing step

target_url.description: Where to deliver each step, e.g. http://localhost:3000/webhooks

name: run_scenario
title: Run scenario
